text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU pool "gpuhot-1" saturation. queue growth 12k -> 35k in 6m, 429s increasing. alert_id=INC-4332-01

bob_oncall: seeing it, paging in. grabbing metrics now.

alice_sre: I'm on call. I'm pulling the hotpath queue, and checking autoscaler logs.

carla_runtime: adding context — recent rollout to tokenbucket tier changes landed ~30m ago, new ratecap defaults applied to gpuhot-1.

bob_oncall: customer impact? any external 5xx?

dana_support: Support dashboard shows spike in customer-reported timeouts to chat endpoints. ~20 customers affected (inc severity: degraded). Escalating to CS lead.

frank_ml: tagging model variants: most traffic is to rwd-open-13b-quant. fallback policy should route to cpu-fallback but that's currently disabled for this pool.

alice_sre: autoscale logs show repeated scale attempts failing with "pool quota exhausted" and "scale-limit hit: max_pods=8". GPU nodes at 100% alloc.

carla_runtime: confirmed. Autoscale loop: attempts to add pods every 30s but ISG control-plane rejects with quota error. Looks like reserved capacity for dedicated customers consumed leftover spare.

bob_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) raise max_pods for gpuhot-1 (manual override) 2) route lower-tier traffic to gpuhot-2 or cpu-fallback 3) temporarily reduce tokenbucket refill for tier-high to cut per-customer concurrency. Which is fastest?

alice_sre: fastest is manual override of max_pods to 12. I can flip it now if infra approves. Needs 2FA.

carla_runtime: routing change is also quick — we can change routing policy key 'fallback_priority' to prefer gpuhot-2 for non-low-latency routes. That takes ~90s to converge.

bob_oncall: I'm going to patch tokenbucket rates first to buy time (less blast radius) while alice requests quota raise. Patch command: 

```
# reduce refill for tier-high to 60% of current
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/tokenbucket/update -d '{"tier":"high","refill_pct":60}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

bob_oncall: executing now.

incident-bot: change submitted: tokenbucket tier-high refill_pct set 60% by bob_oncall at 4332101122

alice_sre: request for manual override submitted to infra on-call (pinging @carol_infra). also opening a short-lived quota increase.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale at 4332101123 -> failed (quota_exceeded). next_retry=30s.

carla_runtime: starting routing override to prefer gpuhot-2 for non-hotpath endpoints. applying ACL flags.

frank_ml: to reduce load further we can deploy an instance of 7b-quant variant as emergency fallback for non-strict-quality traffic. prepping container now.

dana_support: posting proactive message to affected customers: "We're seeing throttling on some endpoints, engineering is mitigating; requests may see transient 429s. We'll update in 15m."

eve_product: please include guidance for clients with aggressive parallelism to backoff — point them to client-side token bucket config (suggest 50 concurrent per key).

bob_oncall: metrics after tokenbucket reduction: queue growth rate slowed, active queue 28k -> 20k in 3m. 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 9%. good improvement but still high.

alice_sre: infra approved manual override. bumping max_pods to 12 now. will watch scale events.

incident-bot: manual patch applied by alice_sre at 4332101136. autoscaler now allowed to create up to 12 pods.

autoscale-bot: scale event: requested 4 new pods; provisioning started.

carla_runtime: provisioning logs show nodes booting, NVidia driver init in progress; ETA ~3m.

bob_oncall: routing + tokenbucket + quota bump strategy holding. 429s trending down to 4%. CPU-fallback not yet needed.

dana_support: customers notified update: "We have applied mitigations; some requests may still experience throttling but overall availability improving. We'll provide another update in 30m." :thumbsup:

frank_ml: 7b fallback image ready. If we still see >5% 429s after nodes up, I'll flip fallback flag to serve 20% of requests to 7b variant for non-critical flows.

alice_sre: new pods joined cluster, autoscale completed at 4332101144. gpu usage per node ~88% now, queue draining.

bob_oncall: can confirm queue: 20k -> 7k in 4m. 429s down to 1.2%. customer pages quieting.

eve_product: collating list of customers affected + ETA for regaining normal service. We'll prepare postmortem blurb for customer comms.

carla_runtime: root cause summary draft: rollout earlier updated tokenbucket defaults for tier-high and inadvertently lowered effective per-pool capacity math, combined with a simultaneous surge in demand and reserved capacity consumption -> autoscaler hit hard max_pods. Two contributing misconfigs: (1) tokenbucket refill values too aggressive for hotpool saturation (should be applied with pool-level headroom), (2) autoscale max_pods default not bumped when tokenbucket changes shipped.

alice_sre: immediate followups (next 24h): 1) revert rollout change to tokenbucket defaults or make it pool-aware 2) add autoscale preflight check that compares tokenbucket changes to pool max_pods and warns 3) run chaos test to simulate sudden 2x traffic to gpuhot pools and verify fallback routing with canary.

bob_oncall: logging this as INC-4332. assigning postmortem owners: alice_sre (ops lead), carla_runtime (runtime), frank_ml (model fallback plan), eve_product (customer comms).

incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated at 4332101148. severity: Sev2. summary: GPUs exhausted due to tokenbucket & quota interplay; mitigations: tokenbucket throttle, routing override, manual max_pods bump, autoscaler reprovision.

dana_support: saved customer impact list to /support/incidents/INC-4332/affected_customers.csv and notified account teams.

frank_ml: leaving a note to prepare lower-cost fallback image for future incidents and an automated fallback toggle.

alice_sre: thanks everyone. I'll start the RCA doc and share the draft in #postmortems within 48h. closing thread but will update if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
